comment: Optional Touch Bar page for autolight (merged into ~/.config/barkeep/scenes.json by tools/install-bar-scenes.py). A key-only scene (no window to match): reach it with a {"scene": "Auto-brightness"} key from any scene or screen, e.g. added in the Scenes editor. {BIN} is replaced by the real bin directory. Every key runs `autolightctl`, so everything here also works from a terminal.
